exposure: health care process during the Zika Virus epidemic
outcome: experiences of humanized practices with bonding
cohort: 25 mothers of children with Zika Congenital Syndrome.
finding: The study revealed that mothers of children with Zika Congenital Syndrome predominantly experienced dehumanizing care and obstetric violence from health professionals during the Zika Virus epidemic, although sporadic cases of humanized practices and bonding were also reported.
